summary: Caesars filed an 8-K disclosing receipt on Sept 15, 2026 of a stockholder demand under DGCL Section 220 seeking books and records related to the Merger Agreement dated May 27, 2026 with Fertitta Gaming Holdco, under which Empire Merger Sub will merge into Caesars, leaving Caesars a wholly owned Fertitta subsidiary. Rather than litigate, Caesars voluntarily supplemented its Aug 25, 2026 definitive proxy, denying any material omission, including regarding Latham's alleged concurrent representations of Fertitta affiliates. Watch for deal timing risk and any further proxy supplementation or injunction threats before the stockholder vote.
